test -f "$compose" || exit 41

test -n "$VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_SOURCE" && test -n "$VIDEOBOT_DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE" && test -n "$VIDEOBOT_STICKER_PIN_STATE_SOURCE" && test -n "$GSERVER_POSTGRES_USER" && test -n "$GSERVER_POSTGRES_NETWORK" || exit 47

docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$compose" -f "$newOverride" config --quiet || exit 50

test "$ready" = YES || exit 52
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$(docker image inspect "$new" --format '{{.Id}}')" || exit 53
test "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=gace-createvdobot --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll -q | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 54
for p in $preserved;do docker exec "$cid" sha256sum "/opt/videobot/$p" || exit 55;done | sort > "$stage/preserved-after.txt"
cmp -s "$stage/preserved-before.txt" "$stage/preserved-after.txt" || exit 56
for p in src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs src/telegram/creatorWiring.mjs src/sales/pgPostingReceipts.mjs;do

 b="$(docker exec "$cid" sha256sum "/opt/videobot/$p" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
 test "$a" = "$b" || exit 57
done
armed=NO
trap - EXIT
echo VIDEO_INVOICE_ONLY_PRODUCTION_READY_PASS
